meta.name: paid-measurement-loop
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "read back" a paid campaign change, "did this ad change work", or "compare ROAS/CPA before and after"; reads ROAS/CPA against a control over a fixed readback window and returns a Promote / Keep-testing / Rollback / Unproven decision with the math delegated to roi-calculator. Not for the ROI ratio math itself — use roi-calculator; not for cross-channel rollups — use performance-analyzer. 付费广告复盘/ROAS回看/投放效果归因

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对比广告投放前后效果，给出优化决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要评估付费广告的ROAS或CPA变化
copy.tagline_en: Compare ad performance before and after changes, get optimization decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to evaluate ROAS or CPA changes for paid campaigns

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你复盘付费广告的改动效果。它会对比改动组和对照组在固定窗口内的 ROAS 或 CPA，然后给出“推广”、“继续测试”、“回滚”或“未证实”的决策。
howto.when: 当你询问某个付费广告改动（如预算调整、新素材、出价修改）的效果，或要求对比改动前后的 ROAS/CPA 时触发。

say.text: 帮我复盘两周前对 Campaign X 的预算提升，ROAS 相比对照组如何？
say.note: Claude 会读取改动并返回决策。

say.text: 10 号换的新素材，推广、继续测试还是回滚？
say.note: Claude 会基于数据给出建议。

say.text: 对比 Meta 和 Google 搜索广告的 ROAS，我有 CSV 导出。
say.note: Claude 会归一化归因窗口和货币后比较。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can review the effect of paid ad changes. It compares the changed group against a control over a fixed window on ROAS or CPA, then returns a Promote, Keep-testing, Rollback, or Unproven decision.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about the effect of a paid ad change (budget shift, new creative, bid/target edit) or request a before/after ROAS/CPA comparison.

say_en.text: Read back the budget increase on Campaign X from two weeks ago — how did ROAS hold vs the control?
say_en.note: Claude will read the change and return a verdict.

say_en.text: I rotated in new creative on the 10th — promote, keep testing, or roll back?
say_en.note: Claude will suggest based on data.

say_en.text: Compare ROAS on my Meta vs Google search campaigns (I have both CSV exports).
say_en.note: Claude normalizes attribution window and currency before comparing.
